subject: Acme POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmefinance.com>, Tom Henderson <t.henderson@acmefinance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Acme POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Sofia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed plan so we can get the POC started next week.

Call highlights:
- Goal: Validate integration of Redwood Inference into Acme Finance's customer support triage workflow to reduce average handle time by 20% and improve first-response accuracy for triage labels.
- Key stakeholders: Tom (Product), Sofia (Ops), Acme security (copied on follow-ups).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or adjust):
1) Latency: median response time < 250ms for 512-token requests under a batch size of 8.
2) Accuracy: model labeling agreement >= 85% vs. Acme ground truth on a 500-sample eval set.
3) Cost: inference token cost target under $0.002/token for test workload (our estimates in attached eval plan).
4) End-to-end: integration demo with live Slack alerting and telemetry by the end of trial.

POC timeline & owners:
- Kickoff + technical onboarding: week of Feb 22 (Marcus will run technical onboarding).
- Trial window: Feb 22 - Mar 8 (2 weeks) to run evaluation traffic and collect metrics.
- Weekly status updates: Mondays, 30 min (Marissa to host).
- Success sign-off: Product + Ops at end of trial (Sofia + Tom).

Immediate asks from Acme to unblock next week:
- Provide a sanitized sample of ~500 customer messages (CSV or S3) and expected labels.
- Confirm the list of IPs/ranges or proxy/firewall allowlist for our test endpoints (see attached network-config-checklist.xlsx).
- Point of contact for security questionnaire: please confirm the contact at security@acmefinance.com (we need SOC2 and encryption details).

Attachments: redwood-poc-eval-plan.pdf (evaluation plan & metrics), network-config-checklist.xlsx

If this looks good, I'll send a calendar invite for kickoff on Feb 22 (proposed 10:00 AM PT) and Marcus will start the onboarding checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: Tom Henderson <t.henderson@acmefinance.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmefinance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) For the accuracy metric, can we agree on the evaluation sampling method? We'll want stratified sampling across ticket types (billing/tech/account) — I can share a label distribution.
2) Regarding latency: is the 250ms target measured from our app to the model endpoint (including network)? We run the gateway in us-east-1.
3) Security: I'm looping in our security alias (security@acmefinance.com) who will want the SOC2 + encryption-at-rest details. They may ask for additional evidence.

We can provide a sanitized 500-sample set by EOD Friday if that works. Also, is SSO required for the POC Console or can we use temporary accounts for the trial?

Tom
Senior PM, Acme Finance

On Mon, Feb 15, 2027 at 4:30 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sofia / Tom —
> 
> Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Henderson <t.henderson@acmefinance.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmefinance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, security@acmefinance.com
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps

Tom — thanks, that all makes sense. Answers inline: 

1) Sampling: agree on stratified sampling across ticket types. Sofia, if you can share distribution that would help us build the eval set. (Tom: tagging this as ACME-REQ-001)
2) Latency: target is measured end-to-end from your app to the model endpoint (inclusive). We'll provision the test endpoints in us-east-1 to match your gateway to minimize cross-region variance.
3) SSO: for the POC we can use temporary accounts for the Console. If you'd prefer SSO, Marcus can onboard via OIDC; it adds ~1 day of setup.

Plan + owners: Marcus will handle technical onboarding (network allowlist, credentials, test endpoints). Laura will track metrics and weekly reporting. I will coordinate schedule and product sign-off.

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Feb 22, 10:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite. Trial window Feb 22 — Mar 8.

HubSpot (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
POC eval plan attached: redwood-poc-eval-plan.pdf
Network checklist attached: network-config-checklist.xlsx

Please confirm the sample delivery timeline (EOD Friday works) and whether temporary Console accounts are OK or if you prefer SSO.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Henderson <t.henderson@acmefinance.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Acme POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps

Tom / Marissa — quick technical notes to unblock onboarding:

- Network: please allowlist these IP ranges for test endpoints: 34.200.12.0/24, 34.200.13.0/24 (we'll also provide hostnames). If you have a proxy, we can work via a static egress IP or provide an agent-based connector.
- Test data: a sanitized CSV of ~500 rows is ideal. Columns we need: ticket_id, text, label_expected. If you can't share PII, a representative synthetic subset is fine. S3 presigned link works for upload.
- Auth: temporary test accounts are fine for the Console. If you want OIDC SSO, we can do that but it will add ~1 business day to setup — please confirm preference.
- Telemetry: we'll instrument request_id and a small set of telemetry keys (ticket_type, priority) so Laura can compute accuracy by segment.

I'll take point on the onboarding checklist once Marissa confirms kickoff time.


Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmefinance.com>, Tom Henderson <t.henderson@acmefinance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps — weekly nudge

Hi Sofia / Tom — nudge on a couple items before kickoff next week: 

- Sample data delivery: can you confirm whether EOD Friday (Feb 19) worked for the sanitized 500-sample set? We haven't seen it yet — if there's any delay, please share an ETA.
- Network allowlist: Marcus requested IP ranges / proxy info (see his note). If security needs us to work through a connector or different approach, let us know today so we can scope it.
- Console access: temporary accounts are easiest for the POC. Confirm if that's acceptable; otherwise we'll schedule OIDC setup and push kickoff one day.

Next steps:
- If we have the sample data and allowlist by EOD today, Marcus will provision test endpoints and we'll run an initial smoke test on Feb 22 morning.
- Kickoff calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30-min-kickoff (I'll send a calendar invite once I have confirmation).

If helpful, happy to hop on a quick 15-min pre-kickoff call with security to answer SOC2/evidence questions — Marcus and Laura can join.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
